title: patch_file failed on .moeb/README.md due to CRLF despite normalization spec
description: patch_file could not match old_string in .moeb/README.md even though moeb.patch-file-crlf-normalize.md is implemented. The file confirmed CRLF line endings from the read output preview. Fallback to write_file was used, but this indicates the CRLF normalization is not working for the exact-string-matching implementation introduced by moeb.patch-file-exact-string-rewrite.md.
proposed_resolution: Debug patch_file CRLF normalization: verify that normalize_line_endings strips CR from both the file content and the old_string before substring search. The moeb.patch-file-exact-string-rewrite.md may have lost the CRLF normalization that was present in the diffy-based implementation.
